question: Which of the following countries is the host of the Asian boxing Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jordan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• **The Asian Boxing Championship 2022 **was held in **Amman, Jordan,** from **November 1 to 12, 2022.**
 
• The event was the** third time **in the tournament's history that **men and women fought in the same championship.**
 
• A total of **323 boxers from 27 countries **participated in the event.
 
• India won the most medals, with **12 medals, including four golds, two silvers, and six bronzes.**
 
• **Uzbekistan finished second** in the medal table with** 11 medals, including three golds, three silvers, and five bronzes.**
 
• **Kazakhstan finished third** in the medal table with **nine medals, including two golds, three silvers, and four bronzes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nikhat Zareen **of India won the **gold medal **in the **women's light flyweight (50kg) division.**
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain** of India won the **gold medal** in the **women's welterweight (68kg) division.**
 
• **Saweety Boora **of India won the **gold medal** in the **women's middleweight (75kg) division.**
 
• **Parveen** of India won the gold medal in the **women's featherweight (57kg) division.**
